issue_request: FHIR-7414 was Published/Persuasive with Modification after asking how OperationOutcome represents business issues such as lack of insurance coverage. The accepted resolution removed the old claim that business issues were conveyed using OperationOutcome and changed Administrative wording to Technical in the old Alert/Contraindication text.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 5790. Git commit 192e425a5dfe7e0bf1684dd8dc97176c9fe4ec7a has git-svn-id build@5790 and changed source/contraindication/contraindication-introduction.xml from administrative/business-and-technical wording to technical-only OperationOutcome wording, matching the Jira resolution.
additional_context: The old Contraindication/Alert responsibility is now represented in the current build by DetectedIssue, while OperationOutcome remains the system-action outcome resource. source/fhir.ini actively includes both DetectedIssue and OperationOutcome. Current OperationOutcome narrative says it is not for clinical or workflow issues and points those to DetectedIssue or other resources; DetectedIssue carries Contraindication and Alert aliases. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current authoritative source no longer asserts that business issues are conveyed using OperationOutcome, and adding new business-outcome prose would be a new substantive decision rather than an application of FHIR-7414.
